reproduction.method: independent rebuild from raw data (binance_vision_quarterly parquet + contracts.json + enriched perp close as spot proxy), throwaway script outside the repo, never touched data/alpha20/tournament/ or any tracked file

dsr.caveat: input is a raw daily MTM series with strong serial correlation within each held position (smooth basis decay); T=1701 pnl-days overstates independent information behind only 38 actual trades — literal-gate PASS, not fully uncaveated confidence

pbo.method: CSCV via src.alpha20.validation.promotion_gate.pbo_cscv on a 1873x6 daily-pnl trials_matrix (union of dates any of the 6 grid variants held a position, 0-filled elsewhere = flat/no-position, the real economic state)
pbo.note: near the ~0.50 value expected under pure noise — the post-hoc selection of entry5_size50 among 6 variants (entry3/5/8 x size25/50) shows overfitting probability indistinguishable from random chance

leave_one_year.method: drop each of 2021-2026 individually from the daily pnl series, recompound
leave_one_year.worst_case_year_dropped: 2024 (single best year; dropping it still leaves +5.28%/yr)

holdout.method: train window 2021-2024 informs param choice, test strictly 2025-2026, params frozen not refit
holdout.not_truly_blind: entry5_size50 was selected post-hoc using the FULL 2021-2026 sample including this period, so 2025-2026 information already leaked into the selection decision — read as a consistency check, not an independent OOS test

overall_verdict: FAILS disciplined falsification — PBO=0.47 vastly exceeds the <=0.10 gate; that single failure is sufficient on its own to reject entry5_size50 as a validated frozen candidate under this program's own rules, regardless of the other 5 checks passing or being directionally consistent
